        self.calls = 0
    def target(self, xyz):

    def run(self, poses, note, video='none'):
        poses = np.asarray(poses, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1,7)
        for lo in range(0, len(poses), 400):
            arr=poses[lo:lo+400]
            res=self.r.submit('ee_pose', arr, dt=.05, video=video, note=note)
            self.calls += 1
